title: Imputed genotype data — Sample QC metrics
description: One element is one participant's sample quality-control record from the imputed genotype data (file ofh_imputed_sample_qc_metrics.v6.tsv).

PID.title: Participant ID
PID.$comment: Many-to-one link to participant.PID; that every PID exists there cannot be enforced across tables (D102). The source states no format, so no pattern is asserted (D043).

plate.title: Plate
plate.description: Identifier of the microwell plate of the sample

genetic_sex.title: Genetic sex
genetic_sex.description: Estimated genetic sex of the sample calculated by Eurofins
genetic_sex.$comment: The source lists no values for this column in this file, so none are asserted; the same-named column in the genotype array file does list values (D126).

batch.title: Batch
batch.description: Identifier of the batch based on the date of genotype calling and the microwell plate identifier

array_manifest_version.title: Array manifest version
array_manifest_version.description: Version of array manifest used to call samples
array_manifest_version.$comment: The source lists no values for this column in this file, so none are asserted; the same-named column in the genotype array file does list values (D126).

imputation_group.title: Imputation group
imputation_group.description: Identifier of the imputation group of the sample
